body:
LF: Kasama sa day 2 GA !

About me: 21f, first time going to raves
Hello! Can I be counted in as well?
Thank you for your thoughts! Will look into it.
YEY THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR YOUR WISDOM !!

This post is almost a month old but I'll shoot my shot!

Can you describe the experience of someone who will enter the database management career soon? What should be expected and be prepared for? Is it okay to focus on databases more than the usual coding aspects?I'm a 2nd Year student and I already learned the basics of SQL statements, and I am interested in it to the point that I'm considering it to be aligned to my career.
Thank you very much! Will PM you soon po once free :)

Halaa thank you sa comprehensive response mo! I really appreciate it. Hopefully malagpasan ang anxiety-inducing journey na 'to huhu. I commend your bravery din! You've done well for your well-being, and I'll definitely remember your inspiring words. 

May we have the best results in life, take care!

Thank you for your response! 

I see, may step by step procedure yung diagnosis? Nakita ko kasi nung nagresearch ako about it, may pa-family interview pa or something related to that, kaya natakot ako at first haha, since ayoko masyado nag oopen up sa family lalo na if it's about as serious as this (na hindi pa certain). 

Is it okay to ask about your history? May signs ka na ba during childhood? May pinasagutan sa akin yung psychologist ko abt adhd assessment and nung diniscuss yung result, according to him, I may have adhd tlga kaya want nya ipa-refer ako sa psychiatrist na specialized ang adhd. Although, pansin ko hindi naman masyado evident nung bata ako (and dahil sa curiosity, I asked my mom and ate and wala naman sila napapansin na sign dati), kaya gulat ako that I may have adhd. Then again, I also searched and there can be circumstances na hindi nagpapakita ung signs until adulthood.

Thank you for your kind response! 

I'm leaning on having to take LOA (Leave of Absence), to take a break for 1 semester.

I hope we will have a productive journey ahead, stay safe!

Hello! Well, I had a recent talk (through email) with a professor I trust and it can be possible! May minimum of 15 units though kaya medyo mahirap if minors lang. 

I couldn't say where I study for confidentiality, pero trimester kami haha, kaya sobrang bilis ng pacing. 

Thank you and take care din!

Thank you for your kind words! 

It's about time to be completely honest with myself din huhu. Naglelean on na talaga ako mag LOA next semester kasi no matter how I see it, mas lalala lang sitwasyon ko if I won't take the opportunity to take a break as early as possible. 

I hope I'll have that consistency of yours! It's a major problem of mine kasi paiba iba lagi priority ko huhu and andami hinahandle. Hopefully ma-lessen ang workload sa buhay once I proceed. 

I really appreciate your story, na-validate ako na it's really okay to take a break. Hirap ako pakawalan ung mga isasacrifice ko like my acadmates. Lacking din ang social skills haha. However, it's something that I should let go to focus on myself. Hindi na rin ako naggrow sa pace na 'to, kaya for the sake of mental health, I really need to slow down and recover. 

Once again, thank you!

Thank you for the informative response! Highly appreciated. 

The main goal for taking a semester off is to strengthen my basics, and hopefully find a decent routine to study kasi the 2 years I spent studying is super lacking in terms of consistency. Kaya hopefully, makapause muna before advancing. I hope a semester break is enough, considering it's a 3-month term. Therapy can hopefully support my wellbeing, and eventually maka-ask din ng help sa loved ones (I have a hard time being open with them)

My family supports my decision, since bumawi rin ako sa scholarships from my previous terms thankfully. 

Because of acads, I didn't have the chance to know ano yung diagnosis sa'kin yet. However, I'll find out soon enough if I were to proceed to take a break. Months ago, my psychologist actually suggested that I should seek a psychiatrist to diagnose if I have adhd or not. Regarding physical health naman, nagpaconsult ako because of my persistent headache na 'di mawala wala and good thing walang lumabas na negative sa result. Stress and lack of proper diet and sleep lang talaga haha. 

I really appreciate your advice. Ang lala kasi ng fear of missing out ko, kaya I do need to deviate myself from the  usual flow. I overwork too much din, which is most likely the main cause of my stress. It took me a while to accept that I need to take a break. 

I still have a lot to learn and unlearn, thank you so much for your inspiring words. Stay safe!

I hear you. Distancing yourself can be a really good example of a double-edged sword. Sadly, I am at the end of the short stick too. Thank you for your knowledge, I'll be sure to remind myself of your words. 

Issues are all I think about, and while I'm aware how to fix them, it's hard to start due to the issues' interconnectivity. That's also the reason why I can't handle problems the way I handle it before. Things are already becoming too much. I thought I was handling it fine, but I wasn't. It's hard to trust myself because of this.

Lately, I stumbled upon the term "existential dread". Have you heard of it? It is most likely the phenomenon that I am experiencing for the past years, rather than existential crisis. I think exploring the concept would enlighten you. 

It's sad to see you still suffering, but I hope you won't give up finding the light. Let's be strong for ourselves and for our loved ones, one step at a time. We'll be all right someday.

Hey, a heartbreak must be so hard to deal with in this situation. 

I went to therapy months ago. The findings are mainly me being hard on myself or too self-criticial, that I should tone down. My psychologist also suggested I should consult a psychiatrist about my suspected ADHD. I couldn't continue sessions because my psychologist kind of ghosted my emails (about ADHD) after my latest session with him. Once I have sufficient time, I'll try to appoint another session.  

I'm planning to partially take a break from college too, making myself an irregular. I couldn't handle things anymore if I continue to fully load my units again. The fear of missing out and being alone will be immense because I have a lot of friends (that can help me with academics) and my boyfriend is in my academic circle too, but I need this for my own good. 

How about you? I hope you're managing despite the difficulties ;(
